output.question: Where can I find General Motors' latest 10-K filing?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, General Motors' latest 10-K is its annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. GM filed it with the SEC on January 27, 2026, under accession number 0001467858-26-000013. You can get it from SEC EDGAR by searching GM's CIK 0001467858 and filtering the filing type to 10-K. It is the most recent of the 17 10-K filings listed there. GM's investor relations site (investor.gm.com) and third-party sites such as BoardroomAlpha also host copies, but EDGAR is the official source.

key_facts.fact: The most recent 10-K for General Motors Co (CIK 0001467858) on SEC EDGAR was filed on 2026-01-27 with accession number 0001467858-26-000013. The 10-K before it was filed on 2025-01-28.
The 10-K filed January 27, 2026 covers the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
EDGAR lists 17 10-K filings for GM, from 2010-04-07 through 2026-01-27.

caveats: The search was run on 2026-11-11. GM's next 10-K, for fiscal 2026, would normally be filed in late January or early February 2027.
The quoted passages are short summaries returned by the page-fetch tool, not exact text from the pages.
I opened the EDGAR filing list but not the 10-K document itself. Any 10-K/A amendment filed after January 2026 might not appear under the plain 10-K filter.
I did not open GM's own investor-relations SEC filings page, so I am not giving a direct link to it. Copies on investor.gm.com showed up in search results, but I did not check them.
